tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// sgrub pa nyams su len tshul bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo rat+na gu ra we/ dal 'byor 'dzom pa'i skal ba can// skye 'chis 'jigs pa'i dad pa can// gsungs bzhin bsgrub pa'i mos gus can// bu shes gsal 'di bzhin sems la zhog /sgrub pa nyams su len pa la// snying rus spyad pa che ba dang*// zhen log ri la sdod tshugs dang*// tshe 'di blo yis thong kyang 'tshal// yon tan rgyud la skye ba la// sdom gsum dam tshig gtsang ba dang*// nga rgyal rlom sems chung ba dang*// thams cad spyi bor khur yang 'tshal// rje yi byin rlabs 'jug pa la// sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes dang*// rnam thar lag tu len pa dang*// rgyun par gsol ba 'debs kyang 'tshal// lta ba go yul ma song la// snang ba sems su thag chod dang*// 'khor 'das spang blang med pa dang*// mkhan po dbyings su dag kyang 'tshal// sgom pa sems 'dzin ma las la// bde gsal zhen pa bral ba dang*// rtsa chad rang sa zin pa dang*// smra bsam yul las 'das kyang 'tshal// spyod pa blang dor ma shol la// gnyis 'dzin rang sar grol ba dang*// chos brgyad mgo bo snyoms pa dang*// bzang rtogs gnyen po bral yang 'tshal// 'bras bu phyi dus mi re la// rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa dang*// mnyam rjes gnyis po 'dres pa dang*// bsgrub pa'i zhe 'dod zad kyang 'tshal// 'gro ba gzhan don byed pa la// smon lam 'phen pa zad pa dang*// rgyu rkyen rten 'brel shar ba dang*// dmigs med thugs rje 'byangs kyang 'tshal// 'tshal ba brgyad kyi dbyangs chung 'di// shes rab gsal la blangs pa lags// 'di bzhin don dang ldan par mdzod// mi ldan bar du bsgom sran bskyed// sa māp+ta mi thi// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
